# Build Guide: Ghoul Commando with Charge (and Pistols)

![Build Guide: Ghoul Commando with Charge (and Pistols)](/uploads/484_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Since March 18, 2025, you and your player can now become a ghoul and receive new perks and abilities. This has advantages and disadvantages. With the ghoul, a new mechanic has also been integrated into the live version of Fallout 76: **Onslaught**. This mechanic now also opens up completely new possibilities, both for ghouls and for humans.

This **commando** (automatic rifle) build makes it possible to play effectively with **pistols** in parallel. This is mainly because pistols received significant buffs to their base damage in the last update and can now be played without extra perk cards. However, you should be careful about using automatic pistols.

### Base: Ghoul Glow & Non-Wild

In this build we make sure that our Ghoul **Glow** (green life bar on the TP bar) is as full as possible. If the glow decreases, we use poisonous water or poisonous slime. You should always have enough of these with you and make them available on your speed bike. You can get poisonous water in many places, e.g. at the Blackwater Mine, Radiant Hills, Toxic Valley, etc. You can get toxic slime in West Tek and in small doses from the slime cooler (reward of this season 20).

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-glow-bar.png)

It is also important not to go wild. Ferocity is represented by the bar above the AP bar at the bottom right. The fuller the bar, the less wild you are. The bar should therefore always be as full as possible. This can be achieved through **Chems** and "The Fix", although we currently only get a few of them in the Ghoul Quest. Tip: Psychobuff fills a lot of the bar.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-feral-bar.png)

## Armor

The armor is a Secret Service armor with the legendary mods: **Des Aristocrat, AP Acceleration, Thru Hikers** and on the 4th slot "**Des Ranger**". By using 5x Thru Hiker, the build saves the perk cards Travel First Aid Kit in Strength and Thru Hiker in Stamina. For good damage reduction with the Aristocrat Prefix, it's best to always have over 35k bottle caps.

Which armor you use is not important, the first mod can also be different. I found Aristocrat useful. The radiation absorption from the environment is very low, so I prefer to use toxic slime to get radiation. Of course it is also possible e.g. a chameleon armor to further improve your stealth ability. If you have already learned the prefix, “Klarer Geist” is also very good. Only Unyielding has no advantage here since you are not playing with low life. The radiation is absorbed immediately, so you cannot play as a ghoul in Bloodstain.

## Ghoul commando build with automatic pistols

### Automatic weapons

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-rifles-commando-fixer.jpg)

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-rifles-commando-ticket-to-revenge.jpg)

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-rifles-commando-10mm-auto-pistol.jpg)

This build uses a Cleaner with Furious, +50 Critical Damage, Fast Reload, and Pinpoint Accuracy. In addition, the track rifle "Ticket to Retaliation" with the 1st legendary effect Raging and double magazine capacity (unfortunately we cannot install a 4th legendary mod here), which you get from the quest "Looking for Accommodation" in Skyline Valley. The 3rd weapon is an automatic 10mm pistol, also with Frenzy, Vital and Quick as well as Pinpoint Accuracy. Since this pistol has an automatic shutter and a silencer, it can be easily combined with a sneaky commando build.
